name: CNC Fabrication, LLC (USA)
old_description: I've had this kit on my 7.3 since 2017. Almost 9 years later its holding up great. Well worth the money.
about:
CNC Fabrication, LLC operates from Bryan, Ohio, where it designs and manufactures performance parts for Ford Powerstroke diesel engines. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials.

The shop focuses on CNC-machined components for the 7.3L through current-generation Powerstroke platforms. Its catalog includes high-pressure oil pump (HPOP) line kits (part 424004 for 1998.5–2003 7.3L) and bolt-on rear four-link suspension kits (parts 428020/428021 for 1999–2010 Super Duty). In addition to finished parts, the company offers engine machining services and engineering support for custom projects.

Customers range from daily-driver owners to competitors in towing, pulling, and racing events. The product line addresses street, track, and heavy-duty towing applications, with explicit fitments listed for 7.3L and 6.0L–6.7L Powerstroke trucks. A 2017 customer review notes a kit still performing after nearly nine years of use.

The company states its vision is to “continually expand our company with innovative, high quality products to better serve our customers all over the world” and aims to “meet and exceed your expectations” with application-specific solutions backed by engineering services and a 21-day return policy.
